newsitem.title: USA: MGE spring wheat ends higher on weather concerns.
newsitem.headline: MGE spring wheat ends higher on weather concerns.

text.p: MGE spring wheat futures closed strongly higher on concerns about cold weather damage to the hard red winter crop and on wet, cold weather that was delaying seeding of the U.S. spring wheat crop, traders said.
Dry weather in parts of the European wheat growing areas also boosted wheat futures in Friday's trade, they said.
Wheat futures volume was estimated at 46.8 million bushels, above the 30.3 million traded Thursday.
MGE spring wheat futures closed 6-3/4 to eight cents per bushel higher, with May up 7-1/4 at $4.30.
Barley futures closed unchanged with May at $6.60 per cwt.
